# Airvio

> Agent discovery index for Airvio products and machine-readable interfaces.

## Products

- [AgenticGraph](https://airvio.co/agenticgraph/llms.txt): Agent-actionable chat-to-canvas knowledge graph workspace.

## Agent Interfaces

- [AgenticGraph Source Files](https://airvio.co/api/storage/llms.txt)
- [Markdown Content Manifest](https://airvio.co/api/storage/content-manifest.json)
- [AgenticGraph OpenAPI](https://airvio.co/agenticgraph/.well-known/openapi.json)
- [A2A Agent Card](https://airvio.co/.well-known/agent-card.json)
- [MCP Server Card](https://airvio.co/agenticgraph/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json)
- [Crawl policy](https://airvio.co/robots.txt)
- [Sitemap](https://airvio.co/sitemap.xml)
